claims.question: How much HBM and what TDP does the HGX B300 NVL8 SXM6 bin have per GPU?
How much HBM and what TDP does the DGX/GB300 Superchip B300 bin have per GPU?
claims.skill_answer: 279 GB HBM3E, 1,400 W (NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra datasheet, GB300 NVL72 column; the widely-quoted 288 GB is launch-coverage / raw-stack arithmetic and appears nowhere in the datasheet). HGX B300 is 270 GB / 7.7 TB/s / 1,100 W.

claims.question: What memory type does B300 use?
What is the nominal and peak rack power of a GB300 NVL72?
What are the aggregate HBM capacity and bandwidth of a GB300 NVL72 rack?
claims.skill_answer: 20.1 TB HBM3E (72 x 279 GB; NVIDIA states "> 20 TB"), ~576 TB/s

claims.question: What minimum vLLM version is required to serve NVFP4 without garbage output?
claims.skill_answer: It depends on the workload: v0.25.1 for multi-GPU NVFP4 with Gemma/Qwen-style RMSNorm (below it, repeated '!!!!!'); v0.32.0 for NVFP4/MXFP4 MoE with expert parallelism on the CUTLASS MoE backend; v0.33.0 for NVFP4 MoE on SM100/SM103 with a padded hidden size on the default flashinfer_trtllm backend. A compressed-tensors NVFP4/MXFP4 checkpoint at a TP that cuts a scale group is unfixed at v0.33.0.

claims.question: Which FlashInfer version hangs with TRTLLM attention on SM103 (GB300), and when was it fixed?
What torch and NCCL versions does vLLM v0.27.0 pin?
What CUDA version does vLLM's sm_107 (Rubin) build target require?
What are Rubin R100's expected HBM capacity, bandwidth, and ship window?
claims.skill_answer: 288 GB HBM4, 19.2 TB/s; shipping, with cloud GA on Oracle OCI on 2026-10-27
